question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

They are institutions built to hold and (continue) power for a political group.
solution:
The correct answer is "**maintain**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word "continue" in the sentence means to maintain or keep going.**(जारी रखना)

 
 
• Example: She continued her speech.
 
 
 
• **"Maintain" is a synonym for "continue" which means to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.**(बनाए रखना)
 
 
• Example: We need to maintain good relations with our neighboring countries.
 
 
 
• Other synonyms for "continue" could include persist, endure, or carry on.
 
• In this context, the institutions are being built to maintain or continue the power of a political group.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (abandon) means to give up or leave behind, which is the opposite of what the sentence is saying.(छोड़ देना)
 
• Option 2 (waste) means to use something in a way that is not productive or efficient, which is not related to the sentence.(बरबाद करना)
 
• Option 4 (release) means to set free or let go, which is not related to the sentence.(मुक्त करना)
